_doc: Issue 2704 -- the interface types the RUNTIME creates entities with on its own, per node interface axis. The ONE source for both build roads:

cmake (cmake/NanoRosRuntimeInterfaceTypes.cmake, string(JSON)) generates each enabled axis's `packages` WHOLE through the backend's per-message hook, so its descriptor table records every type of those packages;

cargo (nros_orchestration_ir::runtime_interface_types, include_str!) registers at create time only the types the executor creates, `registers`, and sizes the Cyclone tables from that count (type_descriptor_sizing::infra_types); the CLI's configure-time refusal (backend_link::runtime_interface_types_refusal) reads `packages`.
`packages` lists every package in dependency order with its dependencies; an axis's `packages` names which of them the axis needs.
`registers` is in ROS form (pkg/msg/Name, pkg/srv/Name); a srv registers _Request + _Response. check-runtime-interface-types-roads holds it to the types nros-node's creation sites name.
